answer: A new identity earns rights on a work terrace, not at signup. It first re-verifies a ledger-chosen handful of already-final transactions, may attest only after those checks match, and may grade only after several of its own attestations finalize. Stages are paced, so a farm cannot promote a thousand keys at once. When many brand-new addresses finish the same proofs in lockstep, that ripple is treated as one funding cluster and their unfinished stages freeze. A raven sampler then demands a unique live check on a current unverified transaction; scripted clones fail the sample and lose the climb.
